description: Story outline: premise, the next beats, constraints

fields.Outline.premise: The story's premise in one or two sentences, at most 120 words
fields.Outline.beats: Beats in order, each a stage of the story (usually 10–30 turns), at most 10
fields.Outline.constraints: Things that must hold, at most 6, one sentence each
fields.Beat.id: Beat id such as b1; when revising, existing beats keep their ids
fields.Beat.status: pending, active (in progress; exactly one), done, or skipped
fields.Beat.intent: What this stage should achieve and what it changes, one or two sentences, at most 40 words
fields.Beat.done_when: One visible, major event that marks the end of the stage, at most 40 words
fields.OutlineDecision.reason: One sentence on why you change it or not
fields.OutlineDecision.outline: The complete new outline when changing; leave out otherwise
